description: A constructor is a body like any other, so it carries conditions like any other: `new Runner(cb)` discharges the condition its constructor derived, at the construction rather than at a call.

diagnostics.message: Call to `Runner` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is non-throwing given `cb`, and the argument passed for `cb` is throwing — its body was analyzed and can throw. `Runner` enters `cb` at src/index.ts:4. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or pass something non-throwing for `cb`.
